About Us

Established in 2011, L&T Realty is the real estate arm of Larsen and Toubro and is one of the top real estate developers in India. With an extensive portfolio spanning 6.50 mn. square metres (i.e. 70 mn sq ft) across Residential, Commercial and Retail developments, the company is currently present in Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, NCR, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai. Every real estate property envisioned by L&T Realty serves as a landmark of excellence and provides customer delight at every touch point, through design innovation and operational excellence. Counted among the prominent real estate developers in Mumbai, India, the business has built a reputation of standing by its promises and embracing the power of digitization and new technologies into its core strategy for growth.

Our Lineage

Larsen and Toubro Limited is a USD 32 Billion business empire and a market leader in an array of industries such as technology, engineering, construction, manufacturing and financial services. Over the last 8 decades, by maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and corporate governance, the company has been able to build a vast network that spans the globe to enable operations worldwide, addressing critical needs in key sectors of the economy like infrastructure, defence, hydrocarbon, heavy engineering, power, ship building, aerospace, electrical & automation, mining and metallurgy. Right since its inception, L&T Realty has also been highly committed to its parent organisation’s vision and ideals. It is this commitment that has contributed to its emergence as one of the top builders in Mumbai and also as one of the top builders in India as a whole.

Engineering AG geändert.</p> <p>Im November 2008 übergibt Armin Fischer nach 24 Jahren den "Führungsstab" an seine Nachfolger.</p> <p>Im November 2009 wurde der Firmenname auf Kempter Meile AG,     Because Forever Deserves Better

    Designing and building luxury homes tailored to your lifestyle

    From the first conversation to the final handover, we’re by your side, making the experience feel as considered and custom as the home itself.

    Our Services

    We provide luxury home building services in Sydney and surrounding regions. Whatever your dreams, block-size, or style, we tailor every home to suit your unique brief — delivering premium outcomes through a designer-lead, collaborative, and considered process.

    External Design

    A collaborative selection experience, expertly tailored to your needs

    With over three decades of experience across the building, real estate, and interior design industries, renowned designer James Treble brings a refined, detailed approach to every custom designed project he is engaged in.

    Available to all of our luxury projects, James will personally lead you through each step of the selection process, crafting a unique internal and external scheme that perfectly blends design, materials, and lifestyle. His broad, guided methodology and world-class industry insight ensure that every selection feels intentional and elevated.

    Why Build With Us

    Personalised Experience

    You’re never just a number — we collaborate with you closely to ensure your home reflects your unique lifestyle, vision, and goals.

    Proven Expertise

    In a world full of uncertainty, for added peace of mind, we provide regular financial stability updates*, in addition to the industry’s HBCF compliance assessments, which demonstrate our solid financial position, supported by over 40 years of experience and multiple industry awards. We bring trusted knowledge, stability, and craftsmanship to every project.

    Concierge-Level Service

    Enjoy a smooth, stress-free building experience with transparent communication, dedicated guidance, and genuine care. Our 100% on-time call back guarantee* also reflects this commitment.

    Custom Solutions, Always

    From challenging sites to timeless styles, we tailor each home to suit your block, your brief, and your future. You will have a dedicated designer to guide you through the design and approval process. Then, industry-leading and award-winning interior designer James Trebel will support you through every stage of interior design, right down to the last lick of paint.

    Family-Owned Values

    As a family-owned business, we treat your home as if it were our own — with integrity, pride, and personal attention. This forms the foundation of our promise, which puts you at the “core” of what we do. For added peace of mind, we offer a 12-month price lock* on the base home pricing.

    Quality Without Compromise

    We’re committed to delivering enduring value and exceptional finishes — homes that look beautiful and are built to last.
